delta.note: Fixed regular income is taken as base salary + fixed allowances + regular benefits in kind, measured in first_month (January for employees hired before 2025, otherwise the first month of work); NPWP/NIK and 'no other DTP' criteria are assumed satisfied. Since all PPh 21 of an eligible employee is DTP, any year-end excess is treated as DTP and not refunded.

output.reason: Grants a government-borne (DTP) PPh 21 facility for permanent employees with fixed regular gross income of at most Rp10,000,000 per month. It applies to employers in labor-intensive industries (footwear, textiles and apparel, furniture, leather) whose KLU is listed in Lampiran A, for tax periods January to December 2025. The DTP cash payment is not counted as taxable income, and any excess DTP is not refunded. This changes the net PPh 21 treatment for eligible permanent employees.
